name: How long does it take to install a typical under-sink reverse osmosis system?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a typical under-sink reverse osmosis system?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a standard under-sink reverse osmosis system typically takes between 2 to 4 hours. This timeframe can vary depending on several factors, such as the existing plumbing configuration, whether a new hole needs to be drilled for the dedicated faucet, and the specific model of the RO system. For example, if your sink already has an unused hole for a sprayer or soap dispenser, it can significantly reduce installation time. Our experienced technicians at CG Plumbing Solutions work efficiently to minimize disruption while ensuring a high-quality, leak-free installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: An under-sink RO system installation usually takes 2-4 hours, depending on existing plumbing, faucet drilling needs, and the specific system model.
